name: TRIVE
recent: TRIVE 在截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度由盈转亏，营收同比下滑 91%。公司同时出现审计委员会与风险委员会成员变动。
notable: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度业绩由盈转亏，营收同比下滑 91%。
Dato' Haji Sohaimi bin Shahadan 卸任审计委员会成员。
Mr Teoh Kim Hooi 卸任风险委员会成员。
risks: 季度营收同比大幅下滑 91%。

news.title: Trive slips into 2Q loss as revenue falls 91%

recent_en: TRIVE slipped into a loss for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 as revenue fell 91% year-on-year. The company also saw changes in its Audit Committee and Risk Committee members.
notable_en: Swung to a loss for the quarter ended 31 July 2026, with revenue down 91% year-on-year.
Dato' Haji Sohaimi bin Shahadan ceased to be a member of the Audit Committee.
Mr Teoh Kim Hooi ceased to be a member of the Risk Committee.
risks_en: Quarterly revenue fell sharply by 91% year-on-year.
The quarter swung from profit to loss.
